new.long_description:
Mad Monkey is turning 15, and we're celebrating with an epic throwback party in the heart of Hanoi!

🎧 Live DJ All Night
🍺 Free-Flow Drinks from 8PM–10PM
🎉 Pub Crawl Through Hanoi's Infamous Beer Street

Start the night with great music, unlimited drinks, and an unbeatable party atmosphere before hitting the streets for an unforgettable pub crawl through one of Hanoi's most legendary nightlife destinations.

Whether you're here to relive the good times or create new memories, this is one birthday celebration you don't want to miss.

Gather your crew, bring your party spirit, and join us as we celebrate 15 years of adventure, friendship, and MAD memories!
